title: workspace.open
description: Opens a project's layout as tabs and splits running the user's shell, each in its cwd, and focuses the first; `pinfold up` sends it. If tabs this root opened are still open, it focuses the first of them and opens nothing. There is no command or run line: with `sha256`, the core reads the root's `.pinfold/layout.toml` again, and only if those bytes still have that hash and the trust store holds the root with it does it type each pane's run line, then a newline, into the pane's shell. The core checks again that the root and every cwd are existing directories and that the layout is within 32 tabs and 64 panes, and on any refusal leaves none of its panes open. Needs hello version 2 and a caller in a terminal outside any pane, so a program in a pane cannot call it.

root.description: The project's absolute directory, which names the workspace.

sha256.description: The layout file's SHA-256, if its run lines may run once trusted.

panes.description: The tab's first pane has no split; each later one splits the pane before it.

cwd.description: An absolute path to an existing directory the shell starts in.

opened.description: How many panes it opened: 0 when it focused tabs already open.
